inputs.checklistItemText: Clearance dimensions measured from utility pole or centerline instead of from outside conductor or outermost electric line as required by code
inputs.question: Are there any dimension annotations, measurements, or notations shown on Sheet 9 (Site Plan) that indicate clearance distances (in feet and inches) from the overhead electric lines (-OHE-) or utility poles to any buildings or site features? Look for text or dimension lines showing clearance values.
inputs.regionHint: along the north-south overhead line on the west side, the east-west overhead line on the south side, and around Buildings 1, 2, 7, and 8

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether clearance dimension annotations exist on the sheet at all (a presence/discovery question), not asking to measure or verify a specific clearance distance. Once dimensions are located, subsequent questions would measure their accuracy against code requirements.
